title: Jatayu's stand
disclaimer: Aerial fight. Jatayu is kingly, not a mascot. Jewels are a continuity prop. Wing wound locks ep10.
story_goal: Jatayu fights Ravana; wings cut; Sita drops jewels.
framework_goal: Aerial fight + new lead (Jatayu) + prop trail (jewels).
gate: Jatayu bible; jewel-drop is a continuity prop, not a one-off.
narrative_summary: The old raptor hits the chariot. He loses a wing. She seeds the ground with metal.

lighting_recipe.key_direction: last west on feathers, then ground dark

fact_checks.claim: Jatayu fights Ravana and is mortally wounded.
Sita's jewelry as a path marker.
fact_checks.source_note: We lock the set from ep08-p06.

panels.scene_description: Jatayu whole: enormous, scarred, kingly. Scale gag: he is bigger than the chariot's pride.
panels.caption: He is not comic relief. He is a king who still flies.

panels.scene_description: Impact. Talons, inlay, Ravana king face readable.
Sita sees a chance. She does not freeze into a poster.

shot_card.camera: her in chariot, him filling the sky

panels.scene_description: The wing is cut. Consequence, not a gore atlas. Feathers.
panels.caption: Kings end each other without speeches.

panels.scene_description: She drops the locked jewelry. Gold specks on dusk.
panels.caption: The same metal from the hut. A trail, not a flourish.

panels.scene_description: He hits canopy. Fall site: broken trees, huge wing on the ground.
Pushpaka recedes. She looking down at the bird. He looking forward.
panels.dialogue: RAVANA: Age is not an army.

shot_card.camera: chariot pulling away, fall site tiny

panels.scene_description: Wounded Jatayu still breathing. Eye open. Testimony later.
panels.caption: He keeps one job: the name.
